description: RootInbox Phase 12B conformance vectors. Call signaling, media crypto, and MCE. Generated by Go backend (pkg/crypto). Frontend MUST produce byte-identical outputs.

call_sas_boundary.note: Val == 4294000000 MUST trigger rehash (comparison is >=, not >)

mce_media.note: All binary fields inside 'm' use Base64 standard padded except file_id (UUID string) and original_size (JSON number)

media_token.note: V-1 deviation: server uses hex.EncodeToString, not Base64, despite RFC-0007 §7.1
